claim: The observe → react composition. An operating model drives WATCH, which reads runtime state; WATCH flows to RESPOND, which recovers. That solid path is required. Two dashed attachments strengthen it where the failure class demands: BEAT adds a liveness heartbeat so a hung process reads differently from a slow one, and BLOCK adds the power to prevent unsafe progress. Solid path: the core path; dashed: enhancement. Dashed attachment: a useful enhancement, not required for the capability.
topology:
An operating model states expected state. The solid load-bearing path runs WATCH — which
    observes the runtime — to RESPOND, which recovers from an observed divergence. Two enhancements attach as
    dashed, open-arrowed strengtheners, not required for the capability. BEAT adds a liveness heartbeat
    alongside the watch-respond path. BLOCK adds the power to prevent unsafe progress. This figure is the
    canonical example of the shared notation: the load-bearing composition is a solid, heavy, filled-arrow
    path; enhancements are light, dashed, open-arrow attachments that read as optional even in grayscale.
required_terms: Solid: required path. Dashed: optional enhancement.
bw_encoding: Only the operating model is lightly shaded, distinguishing declarative model from runtime mechanisms.
redesign: Layout reflowed for a 15 cm monochrome print column; color categories replaced by labels and boundary weight.
alt:
The Observe-React stack: WATCH to RESPOND is the load-bearing path; heartbeats and
    blocking are dashed enhancements
